note: Approved source captures are installed at the recorded paths and hashes. Runtime checks belong to the cited capture report; older linked images retain historical provenance. Generated manual build is separate.

assets.section: Analysis and plotting: navigation guide / Work with several figures
assets.required_evidence: Multiple apo-ferritin live figures of the same type; Current/Stale/Dormant and Snapshot lineage visible.
assets.caption: Independent apo-ferritin figures after project reopening. The Figures list retains live entries and saved categories; a retained result remains editable without a new calculation.

assets.required_evidence: From recipe chooser with input requirements and wording checkbox off; no result computed by opening it.
assets.caption: The From recipe chooser lists its input requirements. Including typed wording is off by default; opening the chooser does not run an analysis.

assets.section: Styles, source identity and element selection
assets.required_evidence: A real source/category series selected; figure-owned color/size/visibility and Project Sources control visible.
assets.caption: A source series in an apo-ferritin figure is selected in Format. Appearance changes and Undo preserve the exact source tables; Project Sources opens the separate shared name/color registry.

assets.section: Styles, source identity and element selection
assets.required_evidence: Style scopes, pinned revision, project/computer sections and overrides; no transient popover in exported artwork.
assets.caption: The Style menu offers figure scopes and Built in, Project and On this computer stores. This illustration arranges two actual offscreen menu captures together; it is not one simultaneous application view.

assets.section: Styles, source identity and element selection
assets.required_evidence: Frame/palette/role sizes/canvas and column widths plus explicitly synthetic preview.
assets.caption: The shared style editor changes look only and previews synthetic points. The preview is not an apo-ferritin analysis or a publisher-compliance check; extra fields remain available by scrolling.

assets.section: Translate the measurement names between tools
assets.required_evidence: Real apo dwell/fit axis and a time input/table in ms, with raw seconds recorded in capture metadata.
assets.caption: A descriptive apo-ferritin dwell comparison displays milliseconds. Raw dwell_s tables remain in seconds; this display test does not validate detector performance or current calibration.

assets.required_evidence: Frozen panels and shared panel-letter style; literal letters and manual position preserved.
assets.caption: Two populated frozen apo-ferritin panels in the composer. Shared panel-letter style preserves literal labels and component snapshots; Update preview prepares a new composition without changing its source figures.

assets.section: Export a selection without generating new analyses
assets.required_evidence: Selected live/Snapshot records, explicit per-figure sizing and final result report without analysis.
assets.caption: Selected-figure export options specify formats and physical sizing. The captured run exports existing results serially without detection, fitting or Update plot.
